messages.subject: PyStan 2.4.0.2 released
parts:
PyStan 2.4.0.2 is available. This release includes significant performance
improvements for those working with models with a large number of parameters.

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

- Mac OS X binary "wheels" are also available.
- Bug reports welcome at https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan
